rationale: Applied the air-density-corrected power curve v_c = v*(rho/1.225)^(1/3) with cut-in 3, rated 12, cut-out 25 m/s, count 8 x 2.5 MW (20 MW capacity). History residual bias = mean(actual - curve estimate) = 0.024847 MW. Each forecast = clip(curve estimate + bias, 0, 20). t04 corrected speed exceeds rated so it saturates at 20 MW.
